findings.title: Host validation regex rejects localhost/single-label hosts used in dev
findings.body: The regex `\A[a-z0-9]+([\-\.]{1}[a-z0-9]+)*\.[a-z]{2,5}(:[0-9]{1,5})?(\/.*)?\Z` requires at least one dot, so hosts like `localhost` or single-word internal hostnames cannot be saved as embeddable hosts. This could block legitimate dev/staging use cases that the old free-text site setting allowed.

findings.title: before_validation mutates host destructively using sub! without nil guard
findings.body: `self.host.sub!(...)` is called without checking if `host` is nil. If `host` is nil (e.g., a bad request or if `category_id` validation runs before `host` presence is set), this raises a NoMethodError instead of producing a clean validation error. There's no `validates_presence_of :host` either, so an empty/nil host could raise an unhandled exception in `EmbeddableHostsController#save_host` rather than a user-facing validation error.

findings.title: Migration does not sanitize host values before SQL interpolation
findings.body: The migration inserts `h` (read from the old `embeddable_hosts` site setting) directly into a SQL string without escaping: `"INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, category_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"`. If an admin previously stored a host value containing a single quote or other SQL-significant characters, this migration will fail or behave unexpectedly. Should use `quote` or parameterized execution.

findings.title: No nil-check before setting attributes on host potentially nil from DB lookup
findings.body: In `update`, `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` can return nil if the id doesn't exist, and `save_host` then calls `host.host = ...` on nil, raising a NoMethodError (500) instead of a clean 404/error response.

findings.title: Pluralized hydration key collision risk
findings.body: The new `_hydrateEmbedded` code for pluralized keys (`m[2]` truthy, e.g. `color_ids`) always writes to `obj[self.pluralize(subType)]`, overwriting any pre-existing property with that pluralized name without checking if it already exists, differing from the singular case which only assigns `obj[subType]` if `hydrated` is truthy. This asymmetry could silently overwrite existing data with an empty array if `obj[k]` is empty/falsy, and no test covers that an existing colors array isn't improperly overwritten.

findings.title: Removed site setting descriptions without migration note / leftover orphan descriptions
findings.body: The description for `embeddable_hosts` and `embed_category` site settings were removed, matching removal of the settings themselves, but there is no check that other locale files (if any) or documentation referencing these settings were also updated, risking stale references elsewhere in the codebase.
